title: Puffins pvp pack
description: this texture packs adds the basic pvp necessities that one requires for pvp , it adds low fire, side shield , less fog and even a cool hotbar style.
body:
[MY CURSEFORGE](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/puffins-pvp-pack)This pack will make your PvP experience absolutely amazing, as it contains all possible functions and aspects, needed for high-speed, smooth and competitive play. The primary aim of the pack is to increase your visibility, speed, and responsiveness in order to provide the highest results while competing.

The set of modifications includes improved visuals due to the simplification of textures which helps to notice an opponent, projectiles and other crucial factors much faster. Weapons, tools and armor become more distinct, meanwhile, particles, fire and GUI are adapted to be out of the way of players in the critical situation. This makes a big advantage for players.

Also, thanks to the improvements of performance and reduction of useless elements, such as unnecessary effects, you will have increased FPS and improved playability. The pack provides you with great advantages to have good results on low-end PCs.

Moreover, there is an opportunity to improve such aspects, related to PvP as hit feedback, crosshair and game-feel in general. The pack increases the player's speed and performance significantly which becomes crucial in PvP.

To conclude, this pack provides you with everything you need to play comfortably and pvply? or some thing.
